description: Byte-identical files to dedup-and-candidates-equivalent-am-first with the tiebreaker list REVERSED to hy-SU before hy-AM. Everything a port could accidentally key on - file contents, load order, tag alphabetical order, canonical form - is unchanged, so any difference in the two fixtures' observations is attributable to the tiebreaker list alone. The tiebreakers govern lookupMatchByLikelySubtag (DefaultStrings.java:2586) and the tiebreaker candidates appended at DefaultStrings.java:2482-2488, so both the selected catalog and the deduped attempted order flip.
